location.zh: 麥克明維爾機場(MMV)，俄勒岡州，美國

desc.zh: 羅賓遜R22教學飛行與空中巴士AS350B3維修後檢查飛行在機場東南側相撞，造成三人死亡
desc.en: Robinson R22 on instructional flight and Airbus AS350B3 on maintenance check flight collided southeast of the airport, resulting in three fatalities

location.zh: 波士尼亞赫塞哥維納布爾奇科區戈裏採
location.en: Gorice area, Brčko District, Bosnia and Herzegovina

desc.zh: 例行訓練中墜毀，造成 4 死 11 傷
desc.en: Crashed during routine training, 4 dead, 11 injured

location.zh: 菲律賓八打雁省利帕市費爾南多空軍基地
location.en: Fernando Air Base, Lipa City, Batangas, Philippines

desc.zh: 兩架菲律賓空軍SF-260教練機於費爾南多空軍基地進行訓練飛行時相撞墜毀，造成機上4名飛行員全部殉職。
desc.en: Two Philippine Air Force SF-260 trainer aircraft crashed during a training flight at Fernando Air Base, killing all four pilots on board.

desc.zh: 阿聯酋航空 EK133 在彭澤上空盤旋等待莫斯科多莫傑多沃機場許可
desc.en: Emirates EK133 circled over Penza awaiting clearance to Moscow Domodedovo

desc.zh: 戰機墜毀；國防部表示機組員已彈射並由地面搜救隊尋獲。俄羅斯媒體另引述未具名消息人士稱兩名飛行員受傷。
desc.en: The fighter crashed; the ministry said the crew ejected and was recovered by a ground search and rescue team. Russian media separately cited unnamed sources claiming both pilots were injured.

desc.zh: Simple Flying 報導該機緊急降落；摘要稱機師曾警告可能有煞車問題，並稱飛機在跑道上停下。
desc.en: Simple Flying reported an emergency landing; its summary said the pilots warned of a possible brake problem and that the aircraft came to a halt on the runway.

desc.zh: 一架法國軍用飛機墜毀；機型尚未獲官方確認。
desc.en: A French military aircraft crashed; its type had not been officially confirmed.

location.zh: 祕魯利馬，Jorge Chávez International Airport（LIM）
location.en: Jorge Chávez International Airport (LIM), Lima, Peru

desc.zh: 發動機起火，乘客與機組員撤離；報導稱無人受傷，起火原因尚待調查。
desc.en: An engine fire prompted an evacuation; no injuries were reported, and the cause is under investigation.

desc.zh: 炸彈威脅後轉降；搜索未發現危險，航班其後續飛維也納。
desc.en: The flight diverted after a bomb threat; a search found no danger, and the flight later continued to Vienna.

desc.zh: 羅馬尼亞F-16戰機擊落兩架疑似Geran-4無人機。
desc.en: Romanian F-16s shot down two suspected Geran-4 drones.

location.zh: 德國萊比錫-哈雷機場（LEJ）周邊圍籬
location.en: perimeter fence at Leipzig-Halle airport (LEJ), Germany

desc.zh: 一輛汽車疑似衝撞機場周邊圍籬，向內行駛數公尺後逃離現場，當局正調查中。
desc.en: A car appears to have rammed through one of the fences protecting the airport perimeter and driven a few meters inside before fleeing the scene; authorities are investigating.

desc.zh: 阿聯酋航空一架波音777客機遭遇鳥擊，機鼻錐受損；旅客在德里滯留17小時，航機隔日上午返回杜拜。
desc.en: An Emirates Boeing 777 was damaged in a bird strike affecting the nose cone; passengers were stranded in Delhi for 17 hours and the aircraft returned to Dubai the following morning.

desc.zh: 客艙霧氣迫使緊急降落；乘客撤離至跑道，摘要稱部分乘客從機翼跳下。
desc.en: Cabin haze forced an emergency landing; passengers evacuated onto a runway, and the summary says some jumped from the wing.

desc.zh: LATAM波音767機組宣告7700緊急代碼，執行2萬3千英尺下降，氧氣面罩落下，隨後返回利馬。
desc.en: The crew of a LATAM Boeing 767 declared a transponder 7700 emergency, executed a 23,000-foot descent with oxygen masks deployed, and returned the jet to Lima.

location.zh: 路易斯安那州Gonzales，Louisiana Regional Airport（REG）附近
location.en: Gonzales, Louisiana, near Louisiana Regional Airport (REG)

desc.zh: 飛機墜毀於田地並倒置；警方長官表示，引擎在撞地前脫離。飛行員受輕傷。
desc.en: The airplane crashed in a field and came to rest upside down. The sheriff said the engine separated before impact. The pilot suffered minor injuries.

location.zh: Borisoglebsk軍事空軍基地，俄羅斯沃羅涅日州
location.en: Borisoglebsk military air base, Russia’s Voronezh region

desc.zh: 烏克蘭武裝部隊總參謀部稱六架Su-34受到不同程度損害；損害程度尚未獲獨立確認。
desc.en: Ukraine’s General Staff said six Su-34s sustained damage of varying degrees; the extent has not been independently established.

location.zh: 美國威斯康辛州Dellona鎮，Wisconsin Dells附近
location.en: Town of Dellona, near Wisconsin Dells, Wisconsin

desc.zh: 飛機墜毀，機上五名成人及一名兒童死亡；飛行員曾通報結冰並請求下降。
desc.en: The aircraft crashed, killing five adults and a child; the pilot had reported icing and requested a descent.

phase.en: Return during a flight to Faro

desc.zh: 機組回報客艙窗戶裂痕並發出一般緊急狀況代碼；航機折返後安全降落。
desc.en: Crew reported a cracked passenger window and transmitted a general emergency code; the aircraft returned and landed safely.

desc.zh: 班機發出可能遭劫持警示後轉降並安全降落；完成安全檢查後乘客重新登機。
desc.en: The flight diverted and landed safely after an alert for a possible hijacking; passengers reboarded after security checks.

location.zh: 臺灣北部、中部及西南空域
location.en: Airspace north, central and southwest of Taiwan

desc.zh: 國防部通報偵獲中共軍機出海，其中11架次逾越中線並進入臺灣北部、中部及西南空域。
desc.en: The ministry reported detecting Chinese military aircraft departing over the sea; 11 sorties crossed the median line and entered airspace north, central and southwest of Taiwan.

desc.zh: 航班途中短暫發出7500應答碼，Eurofighter Typhoons攔截並護送飛機至紐倫堡；Corendon稱無線電通訊系統故障，並表示飛行期間沒有緊急狀況。
desc.en: The flight briefly transmitted squawk code 7500 en route and was intercepted and escorted to Nuremberg by Eurofighter Typhoons. Corendon attributed the transmission to a radio communication system malfunction and said there was no emergency during the flight.

desc.zh: 客機因疑似空中緊急狀況由戰機護送並安全降落；警方稱情況尚未確認。
desc.en: The aircraft was escorted by fighter jets and landed safely amid a suspected air emergency; police said it was not confirmed.

location.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯哈立德國王國際機場
location.en: King Khalid International Airport, Saudi Arabia

desc.zh: 外交部表示，哈立德國王國際機場遭葉門青年運動攻擊，造成1名臺籍民眾受傷。
desc.en: Taiwan's foreign ministry said the attack by the Houthis on King Khalid International Airport injured one Taiwanese national.

desc.zh: 澳洲航空QF5航班旅客反映在近17小時航程中遭牀蝨叮咬，該架波音787隨後退出服務，原定10月10日羅馬飛伯斯返程航班取消以進行深層清潔。
desc.en: Passengers on Qantas flight QF5 reported bedbug bites during a nearly 17-hour journey; the Boeing 787 was withdrawn from service and the scheduled 10 October Rome-Perth return flight was cancelled for a deep clean.

location.en: Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), United States

desc.zh: 漢莎航空波音747-8在洛杉磯機場驚險避開尾撞，機師中止降落，最終延誤近半小時落地。
desc.en: A Lufthansa Boeing 747-8 avoided a tail strike by inches at LAX as pilots aborted the landing; the aircraft touched down just under half an hour late.

phase.zh: 停放於登機門時（先前攻擊所致損壞）
phase.en: parked at gate (damage from earlier attack)

location.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯利雅德哈立德國王國際機場（RUH）
location.en: Riyadh King Khalid International Airport (RUH), Saudi Arabia

desc.zh: 飛彈攻擊利雅德哈立德國王國際機場，造成12人死亡、309人受傷，機場所有作業暫停；另報導指兩天前攻擊中一架停放於登機門的Saudia空中巴士A320系列飛機嚴重受損。
desc.en: Missile attack on Riyadh King Khalid International Airport killed 12 and injured 309, suspending all operations; a Saudia Airbus A320-family aircraft parked at a gate was seriously damaged in a separate attack two days earlier.

desc.zh: 亞維安卡航空航班遭遇嚴重亂流後轉降邁阿密，9人送醫。
desc.en: Avianca flight encountered severe turbulence and diverted to Miami; nine people were hospitalized.

phase.zh: 停機坪與航廈作業期間

location.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯利雅德國際機場

desc.zh: 外交消息人士向法新社透露，青年運動今天疑似發射飛彈襲擊利雅德國際機場，傳出數十人受傷，目擊者稱航廈內人員撤離，多家航空公司取消飛往利雅德的航班。
desc.en: Diplomatic sources told AFP the Houthis were suspected of firing a missile at Riyadh International Airport, with dozens reported injured, witnesses saying people were evacuated from the terminal and multiple airlines cancelling flights to Riyadh.

desc.zh: 飛機墜毀並起火；飛行員與副駕駛生還，傷勢不危及生命。
desc.en: The aircraft crashed and caught fire; the pilot and copilot survived with non-life-threatening injuries.

location.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯利雅德哈立德國王國際機場（RUH）
location.en: King Khalid International Airport (RUH), Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

desc.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯航空證實一名機師在攻擊中身亡，該公司一架停放於機場的客機受損，機上無乘客
desc.en: Saudia confirmed a pilot was killed and one of its aircraft was damaged while parked at the airport; no passengers were on board

aircraft: Bombardier CRJ700 and UH-60L Black Hawk
operator: American Airlines and PSA Airlines; US Army

location.zh: 羅納德·雷根國家機場附近

desc.zh: 美國航空Flight 5342與美國陸軍直升機空中相撞；客機上60名乘客與4名機組員，以及直升機上3名士兵罹難。
desc.en: American Airlines Flight 5342 collided midair with a US Army helicopter. All 60 passengers and four crew members aboard the jet, and three soldiers aboard the helicopter, died.

operator.zh: 沙烏地航空（沙烏地阿拉伯）

location.zh: 利雅得哈立德國王國際機場（RUH）

desc.zh: 機場設施與沙烏地航空航機遭攻擊，造成3名沙烏地公民死亡及多人受傷；一架客機起火並嚴重受損。機型、是否全損與攻擊方式尚待確認。
desc.en: Attacks on airport facilities and a Saudia aircraft killed three Saudi citizens and injured several people. A passenger aircraft caught fire and sustained extensive damage; its type, total-loss status and damage mechanism remain unconfirmed.

desc.zh: 一名男子持假登機證登機並拒絕離開，導致航班被清空。
desc.en: A man allegedly boarded with a fake boarding pass and refused to leave, leading to the flight being cleared.

location.zh: 加州卡塔利娜島附近佩布利比海灘
location.en: near Pebbly Beach, off California's Catalina Island

desc.zh: 醫療直升機自卡塔利娜島起飛後不久墜入海中，機上五人，造成兩死、兩人受傷送醫，一人（病人）失蹤。
desc.en: Medical helicopter crashed into the ocean shortly after departing Catalina Island; five people on board, two killed, two injured and transported, one (the patient) missing.

desc.zh: 空中巴士A350F貨機完成首次飛行。
desc.en: Airbus A350F freighter completed its first flight.

desc.zh: 航班因涉飛行員暴力事件而被改道至沙烏地阿拉伯；以色列官員稱副駕駛意圖造成墜毀，但完整經過未確立。
desc.en: The flight was diverted to Saudi Arabia following a violent incident involving its pilots; your Israeli officials said the co-pilot attempted to crash the aircraft, though the full sequence has not been established.

location.zh: 英國威爾斯Anglesey的RAF Valley附近
location.en: near RAF Valley, Anglesey, Wales, UK

desc.zh: 一架RAF Hawk T2教練機於2026年9月23日下午在威爾斯中部墜毀，兩名飛行員彈射，其傷勢估計為輕傷。調查正在進行中。
desc.en: An RAF Hawk T2 crashed near RAF Valley, Wales, on the afternoon of September 23, 2026; both pilots ejected with likely minor injuries. Investigation underway.

location.zh: 威爾斯北部安格爾西島 Pencarnisiog（RAF Valley 附近）
location.en: Pencarnisiog, Anglesey, North Wales (near RAF Valley)

desc.zh: 一架皇家空軍Hawk T2高級教練機在安格爾西島附近墜毀；兩名飛行員彈射逃生，警方稱兩人傷勢被認為輕微；皇家空軍已展開調查。
desc.en: A Royal Air Force Hawk T2 advanced trainer crashed near Anglesey; both pilots ejected and were thought to have minor injuries; the RAF has opened an investigation.

location.zh: 美國加利福尼亞州優勝美地國家公園奧斯特蘭德湖附近
location.en: Near Ostrander Lake, Yosemite National Park, California, US

desc.zh: 一架歐直 AS332 超級豹滅火直升機在執行投水任務時墜毀，造成機上兩名成員死亡。
desc.en: A Eurocopter AS332 Super Puma firefighting helicopter crashed while conducting water drops, killing two crew members on board.

desc.zh: 尼韋爾航空A320獲准降落04L跑道卻誤降04R跑道，該跑道上有易捷航空A320停放待飛，無線電高度一度降至10英尺後復飛
desc.en: Nouvelair A320 cleared for runway 04L but landed on 04R where easyJet A320 was stopped; radio altitude dropped to 10 ft before go-around

location.zh: 利比亞米蘇拉塔國際機場

desc.zh: 賽斯納引用緯度商務噴射機降落時偏離跑道並遭大火燒毀，機上3人全數生還，檢方隨後對飛行員展開調查。
desc.en: A Cessna Citation Latitude veered off the runway during landing and was destroyed by fire; all three crew members survived.

desc.zh: 一架NBC新聞直升機在洛杉磯查茨沃斯報導巴士車禍時墜毀，機上3人罹難。
desc.en: An NBC news helicopter crashed in Chatsworth, Los Angeles while covering a bus collision, killing three on board.

desc.zh: 在降落階段，飛行員曾增加推力試圖重飛，隨後中止該程序且未部署反推與減速板。
desc.en: During landing, the pilots applied thrust for a go-around before aborting the maneuver, and failed to deploy thrust reversers or speed brakes.

location.zh: 邁阿密國際機場 (MIA) 跑道30

desc.zh: 波音767-300貨機著陸後衝出跑道30，撞擊機場圍牆外公路車輛，造成地面5人死亡、5人受傷
desc.en: Boeing 767-300 freighter overran Runway 30 on landing, struck vehicles on public road beyond airport perimeter, killing five on ground and injuring five

desc.zh: 波音737 MAX客機在都柏林強側風中翼尖觸地並中斷降落
desc.en: A Boeing 737 MAX scraped its wingtip and aborted landing during crosswinds in Dublin.

desc.zh: 一架執行醫療任務的BO-105直升機，在偏遠社區提供服務時不久後墜機，火焰吞噬，造成五人罹難。
desc.en: A BO-105 helicopter on a medical mission crashed after arriving in a remote community, bursting into flames and killing five people.

location.zh: 砂拉越龍勒朗機場附近

desc.zh: 直升機冒濃煙墜毀燃燒 造成機師四醫療人員身亡
desc.en: helicopter trailing thick smoke crashed and burst into flames killing pilot and four medical workers

desc.zh: 飛機衝出機場外圍，進入公路撞擊清潔公司貨車，造成五人死亡
desc.en: Aircraft overran airport perimeter, entered a public road and struck a van owned by an aircraft‑cleaning company, killing five

desc.zh: 航機因機艙加壓問題折返紐約JFK機場
desc.en: Aircraft returned to New York-JFK due to cabin pressurization issues.

desc.zh: 貨機衝出跑道撞擊公路車輛，造成五名地面人員死亡
desc.en: Freighter overran runway, struck road vehicles, five ground fatalities

location.zh: 剛果民主共和國金夏沙恩吉利國際機場（FIH）
location.en: N’Djili International Airport (FIH), Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo

desc.zh: 一架DC-8貨機於降落時偏離24號跑道，導致前起落架折斷倒塌。
desc.en: A DC-8 freighter veered off Runway 24 during landing and suffered a nose gear collapse.

desc.zh: 一架替亞馬遜航空營運的波音767貨機在降落時衝出跑道，撞上機場圍欄外的車輛並起火，造成地面5人死亡、5人受傷。
desc.en: A Boeing 767 freighter operating for Amazon Air overran the runway during landing, striking vehicles outside the airport perimeter and catching fire, killing 5 people and injuring 5 others.

location.zh: 美國加州聖地牙哥蒙哥馬利-吉布斯行政機場
location.en: Montgomery-Gibbs Executive Airport, San Diego, California, United States

desc.zh: 一架賽斯納天鷹小型飛機於跑道墜毀起火，造成機上兩名人員死亡。
desc.en: A Cessna Skyhawk aircraft crashed and caught fire on a runway, killing two people on board.

desc.zh: 緊急滑梯充氣展開並觸及一輛餐點卡車，導致航班延誤數小時。
desc.en: An emergency slide inflated onto a catering truck, delaying the flight by several hours.

desc.zh: 21 Air為亞馬遜執飛的波音767貨機於邁阿密國際機場30號跑道著陸時衝出跑道，撞擊地面車輛，造成至少5人死亡及5人受傷。
desc.en: A 21 Air Boeing 767 freighter operating for Amazon Air overran Runway 30 during landing at Miami International Airport, striking vehicles on a public road and killing at least five people.

location.zh: 澳洲布里斯本斯托克利

desc.zh: 輕型飛機墜毀於農地並引發草地火災，機上2名人員死亡。
desc.en: Light aircraft crashed onto a rural property, causing a grass fire and killing two occupants.

desc.zh: 亞馬遜Prime Air塗裝波音767-300F貨機降落時衝出跑道，造成5人死亡，據報觸地速度高於正常。
desc.en: An Amazon Prime Air-branded Boeing 767-300F cargo aircraft overran the runway during landing in Miami, resulting in five fatalities; touchdown speed was reportedly faster than normal.

location.zh: 蒙特婁特魯多國際機場

desc.zh: 地勤人員於後推作業期間跌倒，遭空中巴士A350-900客機撞擊後傷重不治。
desc.en: A ramp agent stumbled during pushback and was struck by an Airbus A350-900 aircraft, succumbing to fatal injuries.

location.zh: 從普吉島(HKT)飛往德里(DEL)航路上空
location.en: en route from Phuket (HKT) to Delhi (DEL)

desc.zh: 三套液壓系統在4秒內失效，自動駕駛斷開、失速警告、垂直偏離664英尺，造成24人受傷
desc.en: all three hydraulic systems lost within 4 seconds, autopilot disconnect, stall warning, 664 ft vertical excursion, 24 injured

location.en: New York John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK)

desc.zh: 加油車拉扯軟管造成中國國際航空波音747-8受損並導致燃油外洩至停機坪
desc.en: A fuel truck ripped hoses from a parked Air China Boeing 747-8, damaging the aircraft and spilling fuel on the apron.
